item.title: Rallying Cry – October 16, 2026
item.description: From lifesaving medical breakthroughs to inspiring victories, today’s good news includes a new test to detect hidden infections in children and a battlefield drone in Ukraine designed to rescue the wounded, plus a record-setting athlete returning home to cheers and an all-women weaving collective keeping traditions alive.
